* **[Morpho](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/morpho-signs-first-hong-kong-partnership-with-hashkey-s-hsk-chain)**[ signs its first Hong Kong deal with HashKey's HSK Chain](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/morpho-signs-first-hong-kong-partnership-with-hashkey-s-hsk-chain)

* **[Lynq](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/lynq-partners-with-nonco-to-enable-24-7-stablecoin-liquidity-for-institutions)**[ taps Nonco for 24/7 institutional stablecoin liquidity](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/lynq-partners-with-nonco-to-enable-24-7-stablecoin-liquidity-for-institutions)_**[ [Partner]](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/lynq-partners-with-nonco-to-enable-24-7-stablecoin-liquidity-for-institutions)**_

Crypto got the Fed decision it wanted on Wednesday. It held the gains for about an hour.

The Federal Reserve left its benchmark at 3.50%-3.75% in a 9-3 vote and Bitcoin pushed above $64,400 on the print. Chair **Kevin Warsh** then opened his press conference with the line that took the move back: [“There is no soft inflation target.”](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-slips-below-usd64k-after-warsh-says-no-soft-inflation-target) BTC traded just under $64,000 at press time, up about 1% over 24 hours, according to CoinGecko. Ether was off 1.9% at $1,882 and Solana down 2% at $72.58.

Three dissents on a hold is a wide split for Warsh's first meeting in the chair, and the presser told rates desks he will defend the 2% target through the discomfort. Crypto spent most of July pricing a friendlier Fed. Wednesday repriced the chair.

*😴 'Sleepy July': K33 says bitcoin spot volume on track for weakest month since late 2023*

CZ ( https://www.theblock.co/post/410017/sleepy-july-k33-says-bitcoin-spot-volume-on-track-for-weakest-month-since-late-2023?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*K33 Research* reports that July is on track to be bitcoin’s weakest month for spot trading volume since *November 2023*.

* Average daily *bitcoin spot volume* across tracked exchanges reached about $2.2 billion for the month, with the seven-day average at $2.1 billion.
* Bitcoin declined roughly 3% over the past week while remaining range-bound between $60,000 and $66,000.
* Derivatives activity stayed muted as *CME* bitcoin open interest hovered near multi-year lows around 100,000 BTC and perpetual futures open interest stalled near 300,000 BTC.
* The subdued trading levels reflect a broader summer slowdown in market activity according to K33 Head of Research Vetle Lunde.

Caption: July 29, 2026, 2:15 AM ET | Sources: CoinMarketCap, Yahoo Finance, Alternative.me, SoSoValue

## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

This week traded diplomacy, not fundamentals. The US and Iran paused strikes on Sunday, Brent crude[ dropped 7% to $87](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/07/27/crypto-steadies-as-iran-u-s-pause-sends-oil-tumbling-lifts-risk-assets), Ethereum ripped 4.4%, DEXE fell 96% from its ATH, and BitMart announced it was shutting down.

The Fed decides today at 2:00 PM ET. Polymarket says hold. Warsh's press conference at 2:30 says whatever Warsh wants it to.

_**Let’s get into it...**_


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c53930f-b4d7-4e7d-baee-6a88bb56a6da/image.png?t=1781097813)
Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. DEXE Went From $48.89 to $1.77 in 14 Days**

The AI governance token DEXE printed an[ ATH of $48.89](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/dexe/historical-data/) on July 13 after a four-day short squeeze off its listing. Eight days later, wallets that analyst[ morsyxbt](https://x.com/morsyxbt/status/2079843991319883938) linked to the DEXE team sent 625,000 DEXE (about $6.2M) to Binance. The token crashed 85% in hours.

**Whale Intel: **Website up, DAO functioning. But when concentrated wallets hit an exchange right after an 18x parabola, the 'rug pull vs pump and dump' label is mostly legal semantics for the people who bought the top. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a9054bd1-8409-4f84-8a27-1543a399ecc9/image.jpeg?t=1785304925)
Caption: _DEXE price action | July 5 to July 27, 2026 | CoinMarketCap_

### **2. Movement Labs Files Chapter 11**

MVMT Labs, the company behind the Movement blockchain,[ filed for Chapter 11](https://www.pacermonitor.com/public/case/65708680/MVMT_Labs,_Inc) on July 15, listing assets of $100K-$500K against liabilities of $1-$10M. MOVE traded at[ $0.010](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/movement/historical-data/) (July 21). Co-founder Rushi Manche is the largest creditor, with $1.6M according to multiple sources.

The wreckage traces back to a 2024 market-making deal that handed a shadowy intermediary called Rentech[ 66M MOVE tokens](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2025/04/30/inside-movement-s-token-dump-scandal-secret-contracts-shadow-advisors-and-hidden-middlemen) (about 5% of publicly tradeable supply) at launch, which then dumped into thin liquidity.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/
